# multiEpiCore

**multiEpiCore** is an R package for integrative analysis of multiplexed epigenomic data, with a focus on sparse, combinatorial signals generated by HiPlex CUT&Tag and related assays.  
It provides core data structures and analysis utilities for summarizing, comparing, and visualizing multi-factor chromatin profiles across genomic regions and experimental conditions.


## Tutorials
Detailed tutorials and usage examples are available at **https://hiplex.net**

## Install

Install the development version from GitHub:

```r
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}
if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("remotes")
}

options(repos = BiocManager::repositories())
remotes::install_github(
  "Qingjie-Yu/multiEpiCore",
  dependencies = TRUE,
  build_vignettes = FALSE
)
```
